detection limit"],"supports":"Detection of the expected labeled CO signature in both donor conditions, with corresponding unlabeled reference patterns in natural-abundance runs and little or no shows CO without the expected labeled signature under 13CO2, or if comparable labeled CO appears in the matched catalyst-omission control for that donor, the CO comparison is undermined by artifact or background formation concerns.","inconclusive":"Very low CO signal, overlapping fragments, carryover, or inconsistent gas handling can leave origin assignment inconclusive. Even a positive 13CO2 result does not identify why TEA and TEOA differ; it only addresses carbon origin and catalyst dependence of detected CO.","parameter_selection":"Use the same matched formulation, reactor, illumination program, and sampling schedule as the verified benchmark. Because no isotope-analysis recipe is supplied, first establish GC-MS discrimination between labeled and unlabeled CO with instrument-specific checks, then choose sampling volume and run time to detect the smallest benchmark CO signal without overload. If signal remains marginal, prioritize the donor-matched labeled pairs and donor-matched catalyst-omission negatives over expanding the matrix.","limitations":"This card verifies product origin and bounds catalyst dependence of labeled CO detection; it does not resolve whether donor effects arise from photophysics, proton management, medium composition, or cobalt-state changes.
